responsibility: This implementation module implements simple line and string I/O on top of StdIO.Read and StdIO.Write. It reads editable input strings with support for erase, word erase, line kill, form-feed handling, and optional terminal echo behavior; writes nul-terminated strings character by character; and provides WriteLn plus internal erase/echo helpers. Its scope is interactive text handling on the default streams, distinct from FIO’s buffered file abstraction.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the StrIO pair: it defines the StrIO.def API on top of StdIO with line-editing behavior for input, conditional echo/erase helpers, and character-by-character output of nul-terminated strings.
